title: Commercial Bay - FIFA Women's World Cup
description: Commissioned through BLINK agency in Auckland, Nic created character designs and illustrations for a Commercial Bay activation announcing the FIFA Women's World Cup. The brief called for black-and-white line art, used on flags, packaging and printed materials.
